item.text: {"schema":"voice-draft-source/3","kind":"draft","ledger":[{"id":"c1","basis":"request-supported","claim":"A device is not fully owned when its maker can disable features after sale.","request_basis":"a device is not fully owned when its maker can disable features after sale"}],"paragraphs":[{"sentences":[{"text":"The device is yours, until it isn't: a device is not fully owned when its maker can disable features after sale.","basis":"request-supported","claim_ids":["c1"]},{"text":"That sounds like ownership with an escrow agent hiding in the paperwork, holding the useful parts of your purchase until somebody else decides you may have them.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"What exactly did you buy?","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"A thing, or a permission slip?","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]}]},{"sentences":[{"text":"You already know the old answer: ownership means control, within the ordinary limits of owning a physical object.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"You can lend it, repair it, resell it, or leave it in a drawer for ten years without asking the manufacturer's permission.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"A connected device changes that relationship – not because it has software, but because the software can become a remote hand on the switch.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"The box sits in your home; the decisive power sits somewhere else (a neat trick, if your goal is to sell the appearance of possession).","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]}]},{"sentences":[{"text":"Imagine buying a refrigerator with an escrow agent who promises to release the freezer only while you remain in good standing with the appliance company.","basis":"hypothetical","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"You'd call that a rental with a very expensive security deposit.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"You wouldn't accept a car dealer retaining the right to disable the brakes because your account had been closed, or a furniture store repossessing one chair while leaving the rest of the set in your dining room.","basis":"hypothetical","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"Yet when the controlled object is digital, the same arrangement arrives dressed as an update, a service condition, or a small line in a contract nobody expects you to read.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]}]},{"sentences":[{"text":"Of course, the answer comes back that these features are merely licensed.","basis":"hypothetical","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"Naturally, the device remains yours, they say, even if the function that made it worth buying can be withdrawn.","basis":"hypothetical","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"But a license is being used here as a magic word – a way to turn a material loss of control into a technicality.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"If the maker can decide whether your device works, then your ownership is conditional, and the condition is enforced by the seller.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"That isn't a philosophical quibble; it's the difference between possessing a tool and renting access to one.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]}]},{"sentences":[{"text":"I think the cleanest way to see the problem is to follow the money.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"When you buy a device, you pay at the beginning for value you expect to receive over time.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"When the maker keeps the power to disable features, the purchase price starts looking like a tipped minimum wage for your own equipment – enough to get you through the transaction, never enough to give you independence.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"We are told that this arrangement protects security, improves quality, and keeps the product current.","basis":"hypothetical","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"Those goals can matter, but they don't answer the ownership question.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]}]},{"sentences":[{"text":"Security isn't a blank check, and improvement isn't a synonym for obedience.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"A maker can offer updates without reserving an eternal veto over the buyer's use.","basis":"normative","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"We can demand durable local functionality, meaningful repair rights, clear expiration terms, and a way to keep using the features we paid for when the company changes its mind.","basis":"normative","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"If that sounds unreasonable, ask why the unreasonable party is the person who wants the thing they purchased to keep working.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]}]},{"sentences":[{"text":"The industry's favorite defense is that nobody is forcing you to buy the device.","basis":"hypothetical","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"Fine: nobody is forcing the seller to call a revocable permission an owned product, either.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"We should be suspicious of any bargain that gives one side the money and the other side the kill switch.","basis":"normative","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"That isn't innovation; it's bullshit with a firmware update.","basis":"normative","claim_ids":[]}]},{"sentences":[{"text":"You don't need to reject every connected product to reject this model of ownership.","basis":"normative","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"You need to name the boundary clearly: a maker may build a service around a device, but it shouldn't be able to erase the device's promised value after the sale.","basis":"normative","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"We own the object only when our control survives the seller's next decision.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]},{"text":"Otherwise, the device is still in escrow.","basis":"reasoning","claim_ids":[]}]}],"omitted":[{"habit":"opponents-allies-sources / o12: named opponents, allies, and sources with attributed quotations or precise source credits","why":"The request supplies no named opponents, allies, sources, or quotations, and inventing them would add unverifiable material."}],"refused":""}
